pages.title: Excavation at the Edge
pages.text: Obtain a Void Conch or Dragon Dust by genuinely brushing a suspicious block.

pages.title: Excavation at the Edge
pages.text: Open End archaeology as a route to useful materials.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The Conch comes from suspicious End Stone and substitutes for Lapis Lazuli when enchanting. Dust comes from a suspicious Dragon Egg and serves as reusable Bone Meal.

pages.title: Brush End ingredients
pages.text: Brush suspicious End Stone for a Conch and suspicious Dragon Eggs for Dragon Dust. A Conch substitutes for Lapis while enchanting; Dust is reusable Bone Meal.

pages.title: Prepare End creature ingredients
pages.text: A Kitchen Knife opens ingredient drops from suitable Endermen and Endermites. Shulker and dragon products retain their legitimate acquisition; shear Chorus Flowers for petals.
